name: Blobscape
about:
Blobscape is a home for small browser experiments with Gaussian splats: 3D scenes made of thousands of soft, see-through blobs, poked at until they do something new. Lessons, a sandbox, a scene creator and an engine of its own, all in the browser.

The mark is the Gaussian itself, a bell curve sitting on its own x-axis, that turned out to be a blob with eyes. The o in the wordmark is one splat.
construction: A Gaussian with σ = 52 and a peak 116 tall on a 256 grid, its tails ending in round caps of radius 10 that reach exactly ±2σ, sitting 8 above an axis 20 thick with round ends; the eyes are 26 × 38 ellipses at ±22 from μ.

portfolio.alt: A small landscape being built from soft overlapping blobs, a tree, a hill and a rock, with a few blobs still drifting down into place, while a coral bell-shaped blob with two eyes sits on the horizon in the middle and watches.
